Name: M01_M01_INTEL_A
Title: Burn Notice Memo
Body: Kostov Steelworks was declared bankrupt in 2019. This memo, signed by a Ministry official, authorises continued "maintenance payments" of 40,000 EUR monthly. The payments stopped three weeks ago. The informant was the accountant who noticed.

Name: M01_M01_INTEL_B
Title: Container Manifest
Body: Manifest for rail car 7741 lists "agricultural machinery". The weight declared is 14 tonnes. The car only carries 3 tonnes of crates. The remainder is unaccounted for.

Name: M01_M01_INTEL_C
Title: Handler Note
Body: If you are hearing this, I am already gone. They knew I copied the ledger. Get it to Mehta - she is the only one who can read the routing numbers. Do not trust anyone from the Directorate.

Name: M02_M02_INTEL_A
Title: Grid Sabotage Log
Body: The station has recorded six unscheduled brownouts in eleven days. Each one coincides with a night shipment through the northern corridor. Someone is running cargo under cover of darkness.

Name: M02_M02_INTEL_B
Title: Shift Roster
Body: The roster lists 14 guards. The station only employs nine. Five names repeat every night shift: Novak, Petrov, Ilic, Maric, Sorn.

Name: M02_M02_INTEL_C
Title: Storm Protocol
Body: When the storm alert sounds, all non-essential systems shut down for 90 seconds. During that window the surveillance grid is blind. This is the intended infiltration window.

Name: M03_M03_INTEL_A
Title: Project Halcyon
Body: Halcyon is not an accounting system. It is a ledger of 214 public officials across 14 countries, with the price each one accepted. The file is encrypted with a rotating key held off-site.

Name: M03_M03_INTEL_B
Title: Board Meeting Minutes
Body: The board voted 7-2 to continue "client relationship management" despite the Zurich incident. The two dissenting members resigned within a month. Both are now unreachable.

Name: M03_M03_INTEL_C
Title: Zara Intercept
Body: Leon, it is Zara. The tower is cleaner than we thought. Whatever is on that floor, they did not want it leaving the building. Get the drive and burn the rest. I do not want a copy existing.

Name: M04_M04_INTEL_A
Title: Bill of Lading
Body: Twelve containers declared as "machine parts" cleared customs without inspection. The clearance stamp belongs to an officer who transferred to a desk job eight months ago.

Name: M04_M04_INTEL_B
Title: Crew Contract
Body: The dock crew contract is with a shell company registered in Cyprus three weeks ago. The address on the registration is a laundromat.

Name: M04_M04_INTEL_C
Title: Vasic Order
Body: This is General Vasic. The shipment moves tonight regardless of the storm. If the port authority interferes, remind them who funds their pensions. No witnesses at the gate.

Name: M05_M05_INTEL_A
Title: Directorate Memo
Body: Effective immediately, all records older than 1998 are to be digitised and the originals destroyed. The order is signed by a name that does not appear in the personnel directory.

Name: M05_M05_INTEL_B
Title: Vienna Station File
Body: Vienna station has been running a penetration asset inside a private intelligence firm for four years. The asset is identified only by the cryptonym KESTREL.

Name: M05_M05_INTEL_C
Title: Analyst Note
Body: KESTREL has gone dark. Three scheduled check-ins missed. Either the asset is burned or the asset has changed sides. Vienna cannot decide which. Vienna is afraid to ask.

Name: M06_M06_INTEL_A
Title: Guest List
Body: The gala guest list contains eleven attendees flagged in our database, including two sanctioned arms brokers and one serving minister. Security is private contract, not police.

Name: M06_M06_INTEL_B
Title: Ballroom Seating
Body: The seating plan places the minister and the brokers at the same table. The seating was changed four days ago by request of an unnamed sponsor.

Name: M06_M06_INTEL_C
Title: Sorn Speech Draft
Body: Friends, the age of accountability is ending. Governments that cannot keep their own secrets have no business asking for ours. What we build here will outlast every institution that fears it.

Name: M07_M07_INTEL_A
Title: Relay Manifest
Body: The station relays traffic for six regional networks. One channel is unlisted: 44.9 MHz, burst transmission, nightly at 0200. It carries a repeating 64-byte payload.

Name: M07_M07_INTEL_B
Title: Reinforcement Order
Body: On alarm, two helicopter teams launch from the valley staging ground within 12 minutes. Disabling the uplink does not stop them - the launch order is issued by radio.

Name: M07_M07_INTEL_C
Title: Yuki Message
Body: This is KESTREL. I am still inside. They moved the archive to the estate. Whatever you do, do not come for me yet - if they suspect, the whole network goes dark and we lose everything.

Name: M08_M08_INTEL_A
Title: Facility Schematic
Body: Anvil Deep has four pressure zones. Zones 3 and 4 are flooded since the incident. The central shaft connects all four but is sealed by two blast doors.

Name: M08_M08_INTEL_B
Title: Incident Report
Body: On 14 March the specimen containment failed in Lab 4. Seven staff were lost. The report is unsigned and the investigation was closed in nine days.

Name: M08_M08_INTEL_C
Title: Sorn Directive
Body: Continue the program. The loss is regrettable but the data is invaluable. Seal the lower levels, transfer the samples to the estate, and ensure the survivors understand the terms of their contracts.

Name: M09_M09_INTEL_A
Title: Exchange Terms
Body: The exchange is for a tactical nuclear initiation package. Payment is 44 million USD in bearer bonds. The buyer is a state actor operating through three intermediaries.

Name: M09_M09_INTEL_B
Title: Marchetti Ledger
Body: The compound ledger shows 31 transactions with UMBRA over two years. Every one is signed off by the same initials: A.S.

Name: M09_M09_INTEL_C
Title: Broker Recording
Body: You want to know why I sell? Because the men who decide wars never see them. I sell to the ones who do. It is not morality, agent, it is arithmetic.

Name: M10_M10_INTEL_A
Title: Site 14 Program
Body: Project BROKEN ARROW is a directed-energy weapon small enough to fit in a shipping container. Two prototypes exist. One is at Site 14. The other was shipped three weeks ago.

Name: M10_M10_INTEL_B
Title: Test Log
Body: Test 19 achieved 94 percent of predicted yield. The target was a decommissioned frigate at 11 km. The weapon was fired from a truck.

Name: M10_M10_INTEL_C
Title: Sorn Personal Log
Body: They called me paranoid when I said oversight was a weakness. Now fourteen governments pay me to keep their secrets and beg me not to tell. Paranoia is just foresight with better funding.

Name: M11_M11_INTEL_A
Title: Operations Directory
Body: The center coordinates field operations for nine countries. The director of operations is Aldric Sorn. He has not been physically present in eleven months.

Name: M11_M11_INTEL_B
Title: Burn Protocol
Body: In the event of compromise, Protocol VEIL destroys all records and relocates personnel within 40 minutes. The trigger is a single word transmitted on the 0200 channel.

Name: M11_M11_INTEL_C
Title: Yuki Confession
Body: Marcus, I have to tell you something. When they recruited me I said yes to everything. I have done things for them you would not forgive. I am telling you now because you deserve to know who is standing next to you at the end.

Name: M12_M12_INTEL_A
Title: Sorn Estate Plans
Body: The estate has three layers of security: a perimeter sensor net, a private guard force of 40, and an inner vault below the boathouse. The vault requires both a keycard and a biometric match.

Name: M12_M12_INTEL_B
Title: The Ledger
Body: Two hundred and fourteen names. Forty-one thousand pages. Enough to end fourteen governments or to own them forever. Sorn intends the latter.

Name: M12_M12_INTEL_C
Title: Zara Final Transmission
Body: If you are reading this the operation is live. I have given you everything I have. Whatever you decide about Sorn, decide it as yourself, not as the weapon they made you. Bring the ledger home.
